label: prf:chebyshev-degree-genus
title: Proof that Chebyshev degree equals Seifert genus
html:
Proof. The Hecke relation T^2 = s T + \mathbf{1} (where s = q - q^{-1}) gives the recurrence a_{n+1} = s \cdot a_n + a_{n-1} with a_0 = 0, a_1 = 1. For odd n, each step increases the degree in s by 1, so \deg_s a_n = n - 1. Since odd-indexed a_n involve only even powers of s, we write u = s^2 and obtain \deg_u a_n = (n-1)/2.

For T_{2,p}, the Seifert genus is (2-1)(p-1)/2 = (p-1)/2, confirming \deg_u a_p = g(T_{2,p}).

The leading coefficient: the recurrence shows that the leading term of a_{2k+1} in u is u^k with coefficient 1 (each multiplication by s raises the degree by 1, and the leading term picks up no lower-order contamination from a_{n-1}). \square
heading: Proof
